recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16047 unless a future human review identifies stale external/version-transform package content outside this checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-16047 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for the STU3 Condition artifact. It reported that condition-version-maps.html generated a ConditionClinicalStatus conceptmap using devicestatus prefixes and codes, and requested that the mapping be updated.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-16047 was found. The Jira comment says Grahame committed R3 Diff generation-code updates that made the issue go away; October 2018 R3/R4 diff-generator history includes be3a86c452c7c9bf50e875074264efb32606defd, which added code-system URL checking and prevented duplicate value set/expansion overwrites in the diff engine.
additional_context: Condition is active in the current build. Current Condition.clinicalStatus binds ConditionClinicalStatus to ValueSet/condition-clinical, the Condition clinical status value set composes the THO condition-clinical code system, and source/condition contains no devicestatus reference. The old Java publisher path changed by the 2018 generator fix is no longer present. The old condition-version-maps.html page is not present on build.fhir.org, and the public generated page maps clinicalStatus through http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical. The Jira-linked Zulip thread confirms that the R3 Diff tab was generated and being reviewed in October 2018; no Confluence references were found.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current core checkout already carries the correct clinical status binding and value set, and the reported wrong devicestatus mapping is not present in current source or the checked generated public page.
